meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 出问题时，Claude 会按这份指南排查 NanoClaw 容器代理：查看主机日志、查询会话数据库、检查挂载与心跳文件，定位消息丢失、容器退出、认证失败等故障。
howto.when: 当容器代理不工作、容器启动失败、出现认证问题，或想了解容器系统如何运作时触发。

say.text: 机器人不回复了，帮我查日志和会话数据库
容器一启动就退出，帮我排查原因
帮我查这个会话的 inbound.db，看消息到没到容器

howto.what_en: When something breaks, Claude uses this guide to debug the NanoClaw container agent: reading host logs, querying session DBs, checking mounts and heartbeat to find lost messages, exited containers, or auth failures.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the container agent isn't working, a container fails, authentication problems appear, or when you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: The bot stopped replying — check the logs and session DBs
The container exits right after starting, help me find out why
say_en.note: Checks exit code and streamed stderr

say_en.text: Check inbound.db for this session — did the message reach the container?
